summary: Call one tool on an external MCP server through its pack file

tooldef.description: Call one tool on an external MCP server once and print its text result. Not registered for brains: each pack entry's _entry runs it with --pack and --tool; stdin is the external tool's arguments, passed as is.

pack.description: flag only (--pack FILE): the pack (server file) with mcp_server and mcp_tools; relative to the current folder

tool.description: flag only (--tool NAME): the external tool's original name, a key of mcp_tools
